					tagAttr.append(ds)

				    rows = []

		   			# 3. Create the Ignition Dataset

				full.append(dataset)
		self.custom.fullExport.colHeader = colH
		eds = full

config.script:
date = system.date.now()
	now = system.date.format(date, 'YYYYMMDDHHmmss')
	provider = self.view.custom.providers.selected
	filename = '{0}_UDTList_{1}.xlsx'.format(provider,now) 
	
	## Get the dataset (from a table property or a query)
	dataset = self.view.custom.fullExport.dataset 
	header = self.view.custom.fullExport.colHeader
	
	## Convert the dataset to an Excel-compatible byte array
	# toExcel(showHeaders, [datasetList]) returns bytes for an .xlsx file
	excelBytes = system.dataset.toExcel(True, dataset,True,header)
	
	## Trigger the browser download
	system.perspective.download(filename, excelBytes)
